doc.title: Nancy Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Tony Bennett
summary: She admires Tony Bennett and the Tahoe double bill she does not recall.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: I’m crazy about him. There was something else we had in common, because when he sings When Joanna Loved Me, it just – I love it so much. I love that song. Don’t know him that well, but love his voice and love his interpretation.
You guys did a doubleheader some years ago. I think it was in Tahoe.
A doubleheader. What is a doubleheader?
Okay. If you say so. I have no memory.
Somewhere there’s a video of that too. [Live at Tahoe, video might be in the Levy archives]
